parent_policy.relationship: extended, never modified; the parent remains the historical freeze record

correction_reason: The independent Phase-3.2 audit (docs/phase32_independent_audit.md) returned YELLOW. Every score, threshold, confusion count, ranking metric, bootstrap interval and paired contrast reproduced exactly and no scientific defect was found. The verdict was driven solely by reporting conventions and stale current-status prose that misrepresent the existing evidence to a reader, all of which push in the optimistic direction.
post_test_status: This correction was authored after the common test was opened. It changes presentation only. It introduces no new metric methodology, no new uncertainty methodology, no threshold redesign and no model selection.

forbidden_inputs: any estimator fit or predict call

f1_convention.corrected_rule: f1 = 2*TP / (2*TP + FP + FN) when 2*TP + FP + FN > 0, else undefined
f1_convention.equivalence: identical to the harmonic mean of precision and recall wherever that form is itself defined; verified over the 18 Phase-3.2 rows where both apply to a maximum absolute difference of 1.1e-16
f1_convention.why_preferred: The harmonic form returns undefined whenever TP = 0, because precision is either 0/0 or precision + recall is 0. The count identity remains defined whenever any anomaly or any positive prediction exists, and returns 0.0. Publishing a blank where the correct value is 0.0 hides a real negative result: the detector flagged none of the anomalies present at its frozen operating point.
f1_convention.affected_scope: RoboticArm isolation_forest, all five seeds in both regimes

precision_convention.rule: precision = TP / (TP + FP); when TP + FP == 0 report the explicit string 'undefined - no positive predictions'
precision_convention.rationale: TP + FP = 0 is a genuine 0/0. Reporting it as 0.0 would assert a measured precision that was never measurable. This is distinct from F1, which remains well defined and equal to 0.0 in the same rows because anomalies exist in the denominator.

isolation_forest_family_rule.corrected_f1: compute the count-identity F1 separately for each of the five seeds, then take the arithmetic mean of the five corrected seed values
isolation_forest_family_rule.precision_rule: no imputation is invented for undefined seed precision; if any seed precision is undefined the family precision is reported as undefined
isolation_forest_family_rule.precision_transparency_field: defined_precision_seed_count out of 5, reported so the reason for an undefined family precision is explicit

average_precision_prevalence_context.rule: every reported Average Precision value is accompanied by the anomaly prevalence of the identical evaluated slice
average_precision_prevalence_context.prevalence: anomaly_count / total_count for that exact slice
average_precision_prevalence_context.reason: Average Precision has a prevalence-dependent floor, so the same numeric value means different things in slices with different class balance. The RoboticArm target slice is 20 normal and 116 anomaly out of 136, a prevalence of about 0.8529, so an AP near 0.82 there is not strong performance.
average_precision_prevalence_context.auroc_note: AUROC is retained as prevalence-insensitive ranking context alongside every AP value

threshold_transfer_annotation.rule: where a configuration produced no positive predictions on a slice, the reported false-positive rate must be annotated as an absence of alarms rather than as specificity
threshold_transfer_annotation.required_wording: No positive alarms were generated at the frozen operating point; therefore zero false positives coexist with zero fault detections.
threshold_transfer_annotation.note: Any threshold redesign would now be post-test exploratory work and is explicitly out of scope.

cluster_disclosure.rule: every threshold-dependent rate and every narrow slice is reported with its segment count and its independent physical parent/recording count
cluster_disclosure.must_not_present: 466 RoboticArm common-test segments as 466 independent physical observations

known_counts.robotic_arm_target_adaptation: 27 consumed segments / 18 parents, with 96 same-parent siblings blocked
known_counts.brushless_motor: one released segment per recording in the audited release

healthy_target_rule.reason: an interval for healthy-target FPR was not part of the frozen Phase-3.1.1 reporting policy; adding one now would be a new methodology rather than a correction
healthy_target_rule.magnitude_language: report the observed direction and the raw counts; do not describe the magnitude as precise

brushless_motor_confound_rule.permitted: benchmark anomaly-discrimination performance on the released BrushlessMotor cohort
forbidden: any claim that a high BrushlessMotor AUROC demonstrates physical fault sensitivity
brushless_motor_confound_rule.reason: all released normal recordings precede all released anomalous recordings with no overlap, so fault state and acquisition session/time are perfectly confounded and not independently identifiable

sensor_terminology_rule.preferred_wording: three sensing modalities from two physical sensor devices, providing seven numeric signal channels

dataset_representation_rule.release_contents: per-sensor Parquet signal files plus metadata CSV files
dataset_representation_rule.adc_location: original physical dataset collection on the acquisition node
dataset_representation_rule.reading_parquet_is: software deserialisation of already-digital numerical data
dataset_representation_rule.future_live_deployment: would again require physical acquisition hardware with ADC or a digital sensor interface

representation_wording_rule.actual_phase3_classical_representation: raw sensor streams -> 100 ms windows -> 98 engineered features per window -> median of EACH FEATURE across the segment -> one 98-dimensional segment vector -> train-only feature z-score -> classical model -> one segment anomaly score
representation_wording_rule.historical_config_note: configs/evaluation/protocol_b_few_shot_adaptation_v3.json carries a generic 'median of window anomaly scores' aggregation field that predates the Phase-3.1 representation freeze. It is deliberately left unchanged so historical artifacts remain reproducible; it is superseded for the Phase-3 classical baseline path by configs/phase3/preprocessing_primary_v1.json and the per-experiment feature_representation field.
